name: KingOfTheEtherThrone
title: The throne that fell silent
tagline: A crown built in three hours, worn for thirteen days, then left on an empty chair.

chapters.heading: A new throne at dusk
paragraphs: On the 6th of February 2016, in block 963,186, Kieran Elby raised a new throne on the Ethereum chain.
It came three hours after the old throne, v0.3.0, fell silent. This one was meant to fix what had broken: the way it paid its fallen kings.

chapters.heading: Thirteen days of kings
paragraphs: People came to claim the crown. Each new monarch paid more than the last, and the throne passed the coins down to the one it had just replaced.
In all, the chain remembers 21 transactions. The wizard who built it swept his commission and walked away.

chapters.heading: The empty chair
paragraphs: The last call came on the 19th of February 2016: sweepCommission. After that, nobody knocked.
Its code is still there, 2,109 bytes of it, holding nothing. A friendly ghost: no wound, no grudge, only a chair that waits for a king.
